d.ko: A first person car flipping game. Find cheap used cars on your phone, on the side of the road or at storage auctions, and inspect them yourself. Fix what buyers notice, then sell, rent or race them for pink slips. Insure the keepers, take a night off at the casino, and bring up to three friends.
